name: Alliant Energy Foundation Community Grants
summary: Corporate foundation community grants in Alliant Energy service communities; one of three focus areas is environmental stewardship, including tree and prairie planting and habitat restoration.

calls.label: Three review cycles a year
calls.recurring: Deadlines to apply each year: January 15, May 15 and September 15.

status.quote: We accept applications year-round and review them three times a year.

recurring.quote: Application schedule grant cycle deadline to apply grants awarded Cycle one January 15 April 1 Cycle two May 15 August 1 Cycle three September 15 December 1

applicant_types.quote: Funds are only available for 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations, public schools, government entities and tax-exempt organizations located within the communities Alliant Energy serves.

geography.quote: Funds are only available for 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations, public schools, government entities and tax-exempt organizations located within the communities Alliant Energy serves.
